functions.name: GetGravityZ
GetEffectiveTimeDilation
functions.docs:
Multiplies all time dilation sources together and returns the effective overall time dilation. When bAllowTimeDilation is
set to false, this will return 1.0 regardless of the time dilation sources. See SetAllowTimeDilation(...)/bAllowTimeDilation.

functions.name: FixupDeltaSeconds
functions.signature: FixupDeltaSeconds(Target, Delta Seconds, Real Delta Seconds)
functions.docs: Returns the delta time to be used by the tick. Can be overridden if game specific logic is needed.

functions.name: SetTimeDilation
functions.docs: Sets the global time dilation value (subject to clamping). Returns the final value that was set (which may be clamped) even if bAllowTimeDilation is set to false.

functions.name: SetAllowTimeDilation
functions.docs: Sets whether or not Time Dilation is allowed. When true, GetEffectiveTimeDilation() will return the time dilation as determined by the various dilation factors, when false it will return 1.0f.

functions.name: SetCinematicTimeDilation
functions.docs: Sets the cinematic time dilation value (subject to clamping). Returns the final value that was set (which may be clamped) even if bAllowTimeDilation is set to false.

functions.name: GetNavigationSystemConfig
functions.docs:
@return configuration for NavigationSystem's creation. Null means
no navigation system will be created

functions.name: SetNavigationSystemConfigOverride
functions.docs:
Sets a configuration override for NavigationSystem's creation.
If set, GetNavigationSystemConfig will return this configuration instead NavigationSystemConfig.

functions.name: GetNavigationSystemConfigOverride
functions.docs: @return current configuration override for NavigationSystem's creation, if any.

functions.name: IsNavigationSystemEnabled
functions.docs: @return whether given world is configured to host any NavigationSystem

functions.name: IsAISystemEnabled
functions.docs: @return whether given world is configured to host an AISystem

functions.name: AreWorldBoundsChecksEnabled
functions.docs: @return whether given world is restricting actors to +-HALF_WORLD_MAX bounds, destroying actors that move below KillZ

functions.name: NotifyBeginPlay
functions.docs: Called from GameStateBase, calls BeginPlay on all actors

functions.name: NotifyMatchStarted
functions.docs: Called from GameStateBase, used to notify native classes of match startup (such as level scripting)

functions.name: GetBookmarks
functions.docs:
Gets the array of bookmarks.
It's common for entries to be null as this is treated more like a sparse array.

functions.name: CompactBookmarks
functions.docs:
Attempts to move bookmarks such that all bookmarks are adjacent in memory.
Note, this will not rearrange any valid Bookmarks inside the mapped range, but
may move bookmarks outside that range to fill up mapped bookmarks.

functions.name: GetOrAddBookmark
functions.signature: GetOrAddBookmark(Target, Bookmark Index, Recreate On Class Mismatch)
functions.docs:
Gets the bookmark at the specified index, creating it if a bookmark doesn't exist.
This will fail if the specified index is greater than MaxNumberOfBookmarks.
For "plain" access that doesn't cause reallocation, use GetBookmarks
@param bRecreateOnClassMismatch	Whether or not we should recreate an existing bookmark if it's class
doesn't match the default bookmark class.

functions.name: AddBookmark
functions.signature: AddBookmark(Target, Bookmark Class, Expand If Necessary)

functions.name: ClearBookmark
functions.docs: Clears the reference to the bookmark from the specified index.

functions.name: ClearAllBookmarks
functions.docs: Clears all references to current bookmarks.

functions.name: GetDefaultBookmark
functions.docs: Get the bookmark that will be applied when the map is opened in the editor.

functions.name: SetDefaultBookmark
functions.docs: Set the bookmark that will be applied when the map is opened in the editor.
